authority.scope: Create and then delete one optional local continuity record.

event.summary: The fixture records a user-owned request to delete an optional local continuity object and close its mandate.

source.custody: Bundled synthetic fixture; it contains no real reflection content or personal data.

supports: The fixture expresses a complete consent-revocation and deletion transition.
doesNotSupport: Deletion from any real device or service.
That a user was monitored or contacted.

uncertainty: The fixture does not exercise an operating-system filesystem or backup system.
Real deletion tests must cover caches, exports, backups, and recovery paths.

dissent.summary: A deletion receipt must not reveal the deleted reflection content.

repair.condition: Implement and independently test deletion across every real persistence layer before claiming operational deletion.
